rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: VST/log-CPM on filtered genes, PCA with covariate associations, consensus clustering k=2..8 with 80% sample/feature resampling and two base algorithms, PAC and delta-CDF plus per-cluster consensus, a permutation null, bootstrap Jaccard, cross-tabulation and ARI against condition, and library size/globin tabulated per cluster; the only gaps are 500 rather than 1000 iterations and k selected primarily by PAC minimum. QC and filtering are explicit and blood-specific (globin fraction), with a stated keep-and-flag outlier policy. The DE step gives a correct ~condition + cluster design with an LRT reduced model and shrunken LFCs, but the reference level is unstated and the |log2FC| > 0.5 cutoff is applied post hoc rather than as a tested threshold. Enrichment is only weakly warranted here; the plan names collections and reports mapping rate but omits the ranking metric, collection version, and gene-set size window, and package versions are not requested in the report.
